ops.title: Codex final source gates and native owner-shell correction
ops.body:
Accepted immutable capt-hook identity artifact codex.5 SHA256 4cf56a6436c503c99d1162a2424e52b832be4334fff1d59a4719b6172edf5927; independent report /tmp/codex-port-review-hook-identity.txt and note 21075b53540c9c7fb1d6beaedc1910806faa6b61. Reviewer settled/released. Broad make still has one order-sensitive new discovery test failure with 4660 passes; source owner ctx_d8e986c5766c paused speculative full-suite retries while independent read-only ctx_4c77c4695d6b isolates cause. Product wheel unchanged.
Accepted exact Codex 0.155.1/0.156.1 admission binary /tmp/codex-port-bin/cc-codex-01561 SHA256 a92992fb5de9adc55012a97e5d8423d749d927bad68d72634c3390caa44b9808; report /tmp/codex-port-interact-01561.txt and note fb2c95868c12145dd5c45afc159d7f5d0e88b187. Corrected opt-in native tests pass both versions; real hooks, idle/active model ACK and post-completion pending receipt recovery pass. Active-turn history error stays visible without blind resend. Independent TUI report /tmp/codex-port-terminal-01561-final.txt confirms fresh automatic binding and model ACK, but actual tool shell lacks CC_INTERACT_GENERATION. Its selector invocation used an older binary; source owner must preserve this artifact distinction.
Current source owner ctx_a5945ed2f40f (reused admission owner) fixes only cc-skills/plugins/codex/native_owner.go and focused tests after actual shell reproduction: authoritative current registry binding, exact identity equality including endpoint, optional strict explicit generation and downstream fences. Stage owner ctx_8d3275b6debb owns matching skill example corrections and final package assembly. Native reviewer ctx_9383e87c8bde verifies corrected command. No shared-server per-thread env injection.
Five active owners: core build, independent order diagnostic, native owner fix, native TUI/review, final staging. Draft consolidated handoff /tmp/codex-port-handoff.txt remains IN PROGRESS. No live rollout, commits or publication. Signing assets, live runtime choice and desktop app state questions remain unanswered; silence is not permission. Approved plan 486d766 remains executing.
